# Convex Setup Guide

## Step 1: Initialize Convex (Do This Now!)

```bash
cd web
bunx convex dev
```

This will:
1. Open browser to create/login to Convex account
2. Create a new project
3. Generate `convex/` directory with starter files
4. Create `.env.local` with your `VITE_CONVEX_URL`
5. Start watching for changes

**Note**: Keep this terminal running! It auto-deploys changes.

---

## Step 2: Replace Generated Files

After `convex dev` finishes, you'll have:
```
convex/
├── _generated/    # Auto-generated (don't edit)
└── (some starter files to delete)
```

Delete the starter files and create these instead:

### `convex/schema.ts`
```typescript
import { defineSchema, defineTable } from "convex/server";
import { v } from "convex/values";

export default defineSchema({
  analyses: defineTable({
    fileName: v.string(),
    fileId: v.id("_storage"),
    fileSize: v.number(),
    status: v.union(
      v.literal("pending"),
      v.literal("processing"),
      v.literal("completed"),
      v.literal("failed")
    ),
    progress: v.optional(
      v.object({
        phase: v.number(),
        phaseName: v.string(),
        percentage: v.number(),
      })
    ),
    result: v.optional(v.any()),
    error: v.optional(v.string()),
    createdAt: v.number(),
    completedAt: v.optional(v.number()),
    cost: v.optional(v.number()),
  })
    .index("by_status", ["status"])
    .index("by_created", ["createdAt"]),
});
```

### `convex/analyses.ts`
(Copy from NEXT_STEPS.md Section 2.1)

---

## Step 3: Verify Setup

Open Convex Dashboard: https://dashboard.convex.dev

You should see:
- Your new project
- The `analyses` table in schema
- Functions deployed

---

## Step 4: Test from Frontend

Create a test component to verify connection:

```typescript
// src/test-convex.tsx
import { useQuery } from "convex/react";
import { api } from "../convex/_generated/api";

export function TestConvex() {
  const analyses = useQuery(api.analyses.list);

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>Convex Status</h1>
      {analyses === undefined ? (
        <p>Loading...</p>
      ) : (
        <p>Connected! Found {analyses.length} analyses</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

## Troubleshooting

### "Command not found: convex"
```bash
bun add -g convex
```

### "Not logged in"
```bash
bunx convex login
```

### "Project not found"
- Make sure `convex dev` is running
- Check `.env.local` has `VITE_CONVEX_URL`

---

## Environment Variables

After `convex dev`, you should have `.env.local`:

```env
# Auto-generated by Convex
VITE_CONVEX_URL=https://your-project.convex.cloud

# You may need to add:
VITE_CONVEX_URL=https://your-project.convex.cloud
```

Make sure to restart Vite after Convex generates this file!
